remaining_nonblocking_scope_notes.severity: P2 if independent CAD face geometry is claimed; otherwise disclosed scope limitation
remaining_nonblocking_scope_notes.title: Receiving-face geometry still originates in producer membership
remaining_nonblocking_scope_notes.detail: The auditor proves each selected receiving set has at least three noncollinear owner nodes, is disjoint from cuts/loads/supports, matches its native RBE set, and moves according to its DAT kinematics. It does not independently derive the complete exterior x=10/x=20 square face from native tetra boundary facets; the fixed-face selection similarly originates in producer membership. A common producer membership-selection error could therefore be repeated by this file audit.
remaining_nonblocking_scope_notes.recommendation: Describe this accurately as validation of producer-declared CAD membership. Only if independent frozen face geometry is required, derive exterior facet node sets, plane/bounds and areas from the deck and compare the complete port/support selections.

remaining_nonblocking_scope_notes.title: Applied-capacity echo equality permits JSON numeric type substitutions
remaining_nonblocking_scope_notes.detail: Dictionary equality accepts supports:true as supports:1 and floating values equal to integer counts. The current product finish_run parser rejects such values using exact int type checks. Duplicate keys are already rejected by the auditor. This does not bypass the independently reconstructed graph or numerical acceptance, but weakens exact raw-receipt schema validation.
remaining_nonblocking_scope_notes.recommendation: Optionally require exact int types for budget,total and every declaration count when validating the native stdout echo.
